title: Ask
lead: Write it as you would tell a colleague. While you type, the problem takes shape on the right. When it holds enough, you can send it.
box_placeholder: Who you are, what you are about to build or decide, what hurts now, what has already been decided, and the decision this should inform.
container_label: The problem, as read so far
container_note: Mechanical reading, no model; nothing leaves this page until you send. Each line shows the words it was read from. Correct it by writing, not by choosing.

chunks.label: Who has the problem, and who decides
What hurts now, and the evidence

objects.label: the product or app people use
the wording and what is said
data, numbers, a dataset or model

flags.solution: This reads as a solution. The question I work from is what hurts now, and for whom.
flags.method: A question about how I work is not a request; the task contract describes it.
flags.agent_alone: An agent asking on its own behalf is declined; name the person or organisation behind the request.

askback.object: Is this about the public site, the app people log into, the data, or how the organisation works?
askback.decision: What do you need to decide, or get moving, once this is clear?
askback.who: Who has this problem day to day, and who says yes?
askback.current: What hurts now, and for whom? One observed fact is enough.

send_note: Opens your mail program with the request filled in, your words and the reading side by side. If it does not open, copy and paste it in a mail to
after: What happens then: I read it, mail the invoice from my own node, and the reply window of 7 days starts when the payment is seen. Nothing is paid on this page.
